name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PArrIs.mov
typeText:
∀ {m m' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {V : List.{0} Nat} {P Q : Nat} {l : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Nat Nat)},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Agree m m' V →
    (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} V x → LT.lt.{0} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN) →
      Eq.{1} (m' P) (m Q) → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PArrIs m Q l → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PArrIs m' P l

source.code:
theorem PArrIs.mov {m m' : Mem} {V : List ℕ} {P Q : ℕ} {l : List (ℕ × ℕ)} (hag : Agree m m' V)
    (hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V → x < IN) (hP : m' P = m Q) (h : PArrIs m Q l) : PArrIs m' P l := by
  obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, h4⟩ := h
  refine ⟨⟨by rw [hP]; exact h1, ?_, ?_⟩, by rw [hP, hag.pairsAt hV _ h1 h2 h3]; exact h4⟩
  · rw [hP, hag.heap hV _ h1 (by omega)]; exact le_trans h2 hag.2
  · rw [hP]; exact (RecsIn.of_agree hag hV h1 h2 h3).mono le_rfl hag.2
